title: MoLS: SNR-Guided Module-Wise Learning-Rate Calibration for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.05794v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) contain functionally distinct modules with heterogeneous gradient statistics. Although Adam(W) adapts updates at the parameter level, selecting relative learning rates across modules often relies on costly manual tuning. We study this problem through gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Our analysis identifies structural sources of module-wise SNR differences and relates SNR to the attenuation of Adam's normalized mean-gradient component. Based on these findings, we propose \textbf{Module-wise Learning Rate Scaling via SNR (\name)}, a lightweight method that replaces manual multiplier search with one-shot calibration. MoLS estimates module-level SNRs after an initial adaptation period and uses inverse-square-root scaling to determine relative learning-rate multipliers. translated_title: MoLS：面向大语言模型的信噪比引导的模块化学习率校准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）包含功能上各异的模块，这些模块具有异构的梯度统计特性。尽管 Adam(W) 能在参数层面自适应地调整更新，但在各模块之间选择相对学习率往往依赖于成本高昂的手动调参。我们通过梯度信噪比（SNR）来研究这一问题。我们的分析识别了模块间 SNR 差异的结构性来源，并将 SNR 与 Adam 归一化平均梯度分量的衰减联系起来。基于这些发现，我们提出了基于信噪比的模块化学习率缩放方法 MoLS，这是一种轻量级方法，用一次性校准取代了手动乘数搜索。MoLS 在初始适应期结束后估计模块级的 SNR，并使用逆平方根缩放来确定相对学习率乘数。这些乘数在预热阶段被平滑引入，随后保持固定，同时全局学习率调度照常进行。（注：原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MoLS 通过估计各模块的梯度信噪比并采用逆平方根缩放自动确定相对学习率乘数，以一次性校准取代了大语言模型训练中昂贵的手动模块学习率调参。
en_tdlr: MoLS automatically calibrates module-wise relative learning rates in LLM training by estimating per-module gradient SNRs and applying inverse-square-root scaling, replacing costly manual learning-rate tuning with one-shot calibration.
